integrity: Self-contained complete symbolic proof and standalone checker. No independent review or external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to n=2^a 3^b q^c with q>3 prime and min(a,b)=1; no assertion for both a,b>1 or other prime supports. Computation is supplementary to a symbolic proof. Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
title: A complete exponent-one boundary for unitary half-Zumkeller numbers on \(\{2,3,q\}\)
